major_events: The white-clothed God King proposes a marriage alliance between Ye Fan (the Holy Body) and the Feng Clan's brilliant daughter, Feng Phoenix, to provide Ye Fan with future sanctuary, though it faces severe opposition from the younger generation. [第404章 联姻]
Ye Fan strongly repels and defeats Feng Lie in the Zui Xian Que, demonstrating that he will not tolerate arrogance and establishing his own strength. [第405章 助冲关]
Ye Fan visits Miaoyu An and meets An Miaoyi, who offers her support and proposes a deep connection, sharing the Nirvana Scripture with him. [第406章 一场风花雪月]
Ye Fan utilizes millions of Jin of Source inside the Hualong Pool to break through to the Four Cardinal (四极) realm, triggering massive celestial anomalies. [第407章 月圆冲关]
The Innate Dao Diagram descends from the sky to block Ye Fan's path, representing the rejection of the Holy Body by the world. [第412章 逆天接续断路]
The dying God King Jiang Taixu uses his own blood essence and plays the 'God's Overture' to slice through the Dao Diagram and connect Ye Fan's broken cultivation path. [第413章 神之序曲逆天改命]
Ye Fan defeats multiple opponents in God City, including a fierce duel with Xia Jiuyou where he defeats the Jiuyou Xian Qu. [第418章 大幕落下]

Despite the breakthrough, it is revealed that Ye Fan's body still retains a terminal Dao injury from the Innate Dao Diagram, meaning his path is cut and he has less than a year to live, leading the Feng Clan to cancel the engagement. [第420章 终未逆天]
Ye Fan enters the Barren Void Forbidden Land again to gather the sacred fruits and spring water, braving the aging curse and using the Bronze Coffin as a shelter. [第430章 秘辛与进禁地]

Ye Fan completely heals his Dao injury with the sacred fruits, breaks through his cultivation, and triggers another massive lightning tribulation, using it to obliterate a group of enemies who had cornered him. [第436章 天打雷劈]
Ye Fan exposes Hua Yunfei as the practitioner of the Heaven-Swallowing Emperor's (狠人大帝) inheritance in the Yan Capital and engages him in a massive duel, forcing him to escape. [第445章 生死大敌]
Ye Fan and Pang Bo return to Yuding Cave Heaven, rescue the orphaned little girl Xiao Nannan, and save their former Earth classmates, Zhang Wenchang and Liu Yiyi, from local oppression. [第450章 救囡囡]
The Old Madman reappears and casually obliterates the pursuers from the Yin-Yang Sect by simply stepping and using his absolute pressure. [第487章 老疯子灭大能]

Ye Fan, the Black Dog, and the Old Madman enter the Sheng Ya, avoid the ancient Wu Shi formation patterns, confront the corpse of the ancient Accomplished Holy Body, and obtain the complete Xing Secret. [第497章 开棺得“行”秘]
At the Peach Feast in Yaochi, Ye Fan forms a deep alliance with the newly hatched ancient stone monkey. [第517章 结交猴子]
The group discovers the coffin of the Ruthless Emperor in the depths of the Ten Thousand Dragon Nest. [第532章 混沌龙巢]
Ye Fan leads his pursuers into the Saint Spirit's Fall land, triggering his next breakthrough tribulation to eliminate them. [第549章 事了拂衣去]
Under the alias Ye Zhetian near the Qishi Academy, Ye Fan captures the arrogant Nanling Princess Qi Huoshui and forces her to serve as his maid. [第561章 擒齐祸水]
Trapped on a jade altar, Duan De is forced to reveal his cracked bowl's true nature as the extreme imperial weapon cover, the Heaven-Swallowing Devil Can Lid. [第592章 吞天魔盖现]
character_state_transitions: Ye Fan transitions from a Dao Palace cultivator to a Four Cardinal realm cultivator but suffers from a terminal Dao injury, which he subsequently heals with sacred fruits before advancing to the Hualong realm. [第407章 月圆冲关]

Jiang Taixu exhausts the last of his divine essence to save Ye Fan's path, transitioning from a revived, powerful protector to a severely depleted figure who disappears and is believed dead. [第413章 神之序曲逆天改命]
Feng Phoenix goes from an extremely arrogant princess who rejects Ye Fan to cancelling the alliance after his injury, and is later shocked when he recovers and rises to power. [第419章 风凰]

An Miaoyi transitions from a high-status courtesan of Miaoyu An seeking a backer to a deeply loyal partner who shares the Nirvana Scripture with Ye Fan and supports him during his lowest point. [第421章 安妙依]

Xia Jiuyou transitions from an arrogant young genius who wishes to capture Ye Fan for medicine to a defeated opponent who suffers humiliation and holds a mix of anger and begrudging respect. [第418章 大幕落下]
The Old Madman transitions from a state of chaotic, dazed madness to moments of supreme clarity and absolute power where he easily obliterates grandmasters of the Yin-Yang Sect. [第484章 老疯子出手]

Hua Yunfei transitions from a gentle, lute-playing disciple of Taixuan to being exposed as a ruthless, deep-scheming demonic heir, and is eventually defeated by Ye Fan and forced into hiding. [第443章 狠人传承者]
Xiao Nannan transitions from a helpless, orphaned beggar girl in the Yan Capital to a companion protected by Ye Fan, showing supernatural traits and immunity to curses. [第428章 小囡囡]
Qi Huoshui transitions from a proud, spoiled princess of Nanling to a frustrated captive forced to serve as a maid in the Wild Cottage under Ye Fan's alias. [第562章 郡主侍女]

Duan De transitions from a sneaky grave-robber who hides his treasures under a cracked bowl to being forced by extreme danger to reveal his ultimate trump card: the Heaven-Swallowing Devil Can Lid. [第592章 吞天魔盖现]
long_form_mechanisms: The Holy Body's breakthrough into the Four Cardinal realm requires millions of Jin of Source to fill the Hualong Pool and triggers an innate cosmic rejection where the Innate Dao Diagram descends to sever the practitioner's connection to the Dao. [第412章 逆天接续断路]

The Dao injury is a spiritual degradation caused by the rejection of the heavenly laws, resisting standard healing herbs and requiring ancient scriptures or supreme divine medicine to heal and rebuild the foundation. [第420章 终未逆天]

The Xing Secret of the Nine Secrets is the ultimate speed technique that, when fully mastered, allows the user to step through space and time, bypassing defensive arrays and escaping traps. [第497章 开棺得“行”秘]

The God's Overture is a musical divine technique of the Jiang family that interacts directly with the laws of heaven and earth, capable of cleansing and forcefully modifying the physical/spiritual path of a cultivator. [第413章 神之序曲逆天改命]

The Heavenly Tribulation acts as a tactical weapon where a cultivator delays breakthroughs to trigger a tribulation that automatically targets and scales in intensity to eliminate anyone inside the area. [第436章 天打雷劈]

The Extreme Imperial Weapon split state allows parts of an imperial weapon, such as the Devil Can Lid, to be kept separately while still possessing immense imperial pressure, unleashing supreme power when reunited. [第592章 吞天魔盖现]

The Great Dragon Tribulation is a highly dangerous form of Heavenly Tribulation triggered when breaking through to the Hualong realm, manifesting as lightning dragons that test the physical body. [第577章 大龙劫]

The Godmind represents the residual evil thoughts left behind by a deceased ancient god or emperor, possessing immense negative power that suppresses high-level cultivators unless countered by sacred scriptures. [第582章 神o念]
continuity_observations: Ye Fan's Hualong Pool breakthrough consumes a massive amount of source (millions of jin), which continues the established lore that the Holy Body is a path too expensive for ordinary sects to support. [第407章 月圆冲关]

In the prior arcs, Jiang Taixu was rescued from the Purple Mountain and was near death. This chunk shows the resolution of his arc where he exhausts his remaining life force to help Ye Fan, explaining his subsequent disappearance. [第413章 神之序曲逆天改命]

Ye Fan's ability to survive the aging curse when he goes back to collect the sacred fruits is directly tied to the fact that he drank the spring water and ate the fruits in the opening chapters of the novel. [第430章 秘辛与进禁地]

The Old Madman's movement technique is recognized by the Black Dog and Ye Fan as related to the Xing Secret, which links back to when they first saw him crazy-stepping in the Taixuan Sect arc. [第480章 老疯子同行]
Ye Fan's discovery of the star charts inside the Bronze Coffin in the Barren Void Abyss directly continues the mystery of the Nine Dragons Pulling the Coffin from Earth. [第432章 又见五色祭坛]

The return of Zhang Wenchang and Liu Yiyi, and their poor treatment in the Yuding Cave Heaven, provides continuity for the Earth group's fates after they were separated in the early chapters. [第450章 救囡囡]

The crying-smiling face on the Devil Can Lid matches the emblem seen on Nannan's wooden tag and the Ruthless Emperor's historical traces, hinting at Nannan's true origin and connection to the Emperor. [第592章 吞天魔盖现]

The Black Dog's recurring mistakes in carving teleportation coordinate patterns, leading the group to random, dangerous locations, continues a running gag and plot device established in previous arcs. [第527章 蓄势引入翁]
style_observations: The author heavily relies on 'witnesses' (passersby, holy sons, old monsters) to narrate the weight of Ye Fan's actions, using expressions like '众人皆惊' or '倒吸冷气' to build tension. [第411章 圣体断路]
The prose fluctuates between grand, poetic descriptions of divine techniques and slapstick physical humor, such as spanking Xia Jiuyou or stripping Duan De. [第418章 大幕落下]
Frequent use of terms like '绝代', '妖孽', '震古烁今', '惊天地泣鬼神' to emphasize the rarity and power of characters and events. [第416章 仙王战九幽]
Ending chapters on a philosophical or nostalgic note, particularly regarding the transient nature of history, the death of great emperors, or the weight of time. [第534章 惊见太古人族圣人]
The narrative frames Ye Fan's aggressive and sometimes ruthless actions as righteous or humorous responses to the hypocrisy and greed of his enemies. [第572章 扒光]
The characters frequently pause their grand adventures to eat spiritual beasts and drink ancient wines, highlighting a 'xianxia lifestyle' aspect. [第559章 史上最牛领主]

creation_family_evidence.title_and_edition: The source file name '《遮天》（精校版全本）作者：辰东.txt' indicates it is a meticulously proofread and completed edition of the web novel by author Chen Dong.
creation_family_evidence.chapter_heading_regularity: The text features uniform chapter division formatting using Chinese numerals ('第404章' to '第592章') followed by a space and a title. This represents the typical structure of a cleaned web novel compilation.
creation_family_evidence.textual_content_and_universe: The story revolves around Ye Fan and specific unique terminology created by Chen Dong, such as the Accomplished Holy Body ('大成圣体'), White-clothed God King ('白衣神王'), extreme imperial weapons ('极道帝兵'), and locations like Holy Cliff ('圣崖') and Barren Void Forbidden Land ('荒古静地').
creation_family_evidence.compilation_formatting: The paragraphs in the text consistently start with double-byte full-width spaces (\u3000\u3000), confirming standard Zhi Xuan Cang Shu web serialization formatting.

originality_risks: The Saint Prince is a golden-furred monkey born from a stone egg, fighting with a heavy staff, which is a direct adaptation of Sun Wukong from the classic Chinese novel Journey to the West. [第517章 结交猴子]

The Black Dog (黑皇) fits the standard trope of a greedy, arrogant, but secretly knowledgeable animal companion that provides comic relief and convenient teleportation plots, common in Chinese web novels. [第527章 蓄势引入翁]
The concept of the 'Nine Secrets' is based on the Daoist 'Nine Characters' (临兵斗者皆阵列前行) from the Baopuzi, mapping real-world esoteric Daoism directly into the magic system. [第497章 开棺得“行”秘]
The backstory of the Ruthless Emperor—defying heaven and creating a demonic path out of grief for her dead brother—draws heavily on Chinese folklore about sibling sacrifice and tragedy. [第531章 狠人的葬地]
